state.decision_rationale: Accepted as explicit exact, numbered, signatures, outline, reference, and alias projections.

provenance.source_label: Claude Fable feature idea: projection tiers per file
provenance.review_target: Reported 39479-line MKTCTX/3 packet; exact artifact not identified

feedback.verbatim: Add outline, signatures, and elided projections so one packet can serve mixed fidelity under a budget. mode=lossless implies lossy modes exist; specify them.
feedback.normalized_claim: Let one packet assign exact, structural, signature-only, or identity-only representations per file, with explicit loss and coverage semantics.

current_behavior: The type-level projection vocabulary contains exact, numbered, and alias; numbered is a citation view rather than a smaller semantic summary.
Global outlines exist even when file bodies are exact, but outline-only or signature-only file projections are not implemented.
The packet mode is lossless even when repository coverage is incomplete, a terminology issue already captured separately.

proposal.summary: Treat mixed-fidelity file projections as the concrete wire-level portion of the broader projection-tier and budget-profile design.
candidate_changes: Define exact, numbered, outline, signatures, summary, and elided or reference projections with explicit reconstruction and loss guarantees.
Require per-file projection reason, source content hash, availability posture, and link to exact authority when applicable.
Specify alias behavior when canonical and alias paths receive different requested fidelities.
Test mixed packets with graph-ranked and caller-declared policies.
non_goals: Do not imply outline or signature projections can reconstruct source bytes.
Do not overload alias as a lossy projection.
Do not add model-generated summaries without provenance and authority boundaries.

questions: Which projections belong to the normative core and which are optional analyzer capabilities?
Can a consumer request or upgrade one file without regenerating the entire packet?
How are projection-specific hashes and citations defined?
risks: Mixed fidelity increases the chance that consumers mistake a summary for exact source.
Projection-specific identity can complicate aliases and durable citations.
Too many variants can impair interoperability.
evidence_needed: Wire examples and round-trip capability tests for every projection.
Model task evaluations at matched budgets.
Parser behavior when encountering unsupported projections.
